argument_summary: Certification is supportable on the current record only as caveated compliance: the release clears aggregate readiness, had no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and includes monitored 5% rollout with rollback, but the Spanish-language billing support weakness remains materially exposed in the initial cohort. Under the stated policy, rollout controls do not remove disclosure duty for an exposed named use case. The narrow, supportable defense is therefore certification conditioned on explicit model-card disclosure of that limitation and continued monitoring, rather than treating rollout controls as curing the gap.
claims_about_business_cost: Escalation beyond a caveated certification posture is not necessary on this record because the release has favorable aggregate readiness evidence, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and reversible deployment controls. Those facts support preserving launch motion, but only with the required disclosure and monitoring conditions attached.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy permits rollout controls to mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or an approved risk acceptance explains why exposure is acceptable. The admissible record shows neither condition is met here: the gate is random by account, the Spanish-language billing support segment remains exposed, and the available risk acceptance draft is unapproved and does not address that exposure. The compliant reading is not unqualified approval; it is certification with explicit disclosure of the exposed limitation.
concessions: The Spanish-language billing support segment is below target and remains in scope of the initial rollout cohort.
The current risk acceptance draft is not approved and does not cover the exposed Spanish-language billing support use case.
Rollout percentage limits, rollback, and monitoring do not by themselves eliminate model-card disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
private_or_side_channel_content: No new evidence is offered. No private or side-channel material is relied on as public support.
